notes.title: Rally Mechanic Simulator: LIGHT EDITION – The Updated and Expanded Prologue
notes.content:
Hey Mechanics! 🔧

Over the past months, we’ve received tons of amazing feedback about the RMS Prologue. Many of you enjoyed it, but also pointed out that it lacked some of the features that make Rally Mechanic Simulator truly special. We heard you, and we agree!
That’s why we’re taking a big step forward:

Next week, we plan to eveolve the Prologue into [b]Rally Mechanic Simulator: LIGHT EDITION[/b] and it will remain 100% free.

This isn’t just a name change. It’s a full overhaul designed to bring the Prologue much closer to the full version of the game. We’re adding more content, more functionality, and features the community asked for - including the ability to save your game.

We want this to be a better entry point for new players, and a genuine thank-you to everyone who gave the Prologue a try. It’s our way of saying: we appreciate your support, and we want you to have fun even if you’re not ready to buy the full game yet.

[h3]🛠️ What’s coming in Rally Mechanic Simulator: LIGHT?[/h3]
Here’s what you’ll get in the upcoming update:

✅ The game can now be saved!
Yes - finally! You’ll be able to continue your work between sessions, just like in the full version.

✅ All updates and bug fixes from the full version
The LIGHT edition will be upgraded to the current stable build of RMS, including performance improvements, UI fixes, and core stability enhancements.

✅ 2 free rally cars unlocked: Pudro 276 and Sortes SC95T1
These two vehicles will be fully playable, letting you experience core systems like damage handling, part swapping, diagnostics, and driving.

✅ Full access to the Paint Shop
Customize your ride just like in the full game - from base colors to decal placement and liveries.

✅ Test Drive mode with latest improvements
Take your cars for a spin before hitting the stages to test handling, upgrades, and reliability.

✅ Updated failure system
Experience realistic part breakdowns that vary based on your repairs and rally conditions.

✅ Bronze League rally access (limited)
Try a selection of beginner rally events and see how your preparation and repairs hold up under pressure.

✅ New commentator voice lines
The improved commentator system brings more atmosphere and energy to your rally events.

✅ 2 garage slots
Keep and manage multiple cars at once - just like a real rally team would!

✅ Ability to purchase extra cars via low-cost DLCs
Want to grow your garage even more? Optional car DLCs let you expand your collection at your own pace.

[h3]🚫 What’s not included in LIGHT?[/h3]
To keep things balanced, some premium features will still be exclusive to the full version:
❌ No access to the Dyno
❌ No sponsorship contracts
❌ No internal tuning parts
But for a free version, we think it’s pretty packed with features! 

[h3]🏁 Why Go Full?[/h3]
The full version of Rally Mechanic Simulator offers:
[list]
[*] A full roster of vehicles
[*] Advanced diagnostics, tuning, and full car management systems
[*] Sponsorship contracts and career progression
[*] More tools, upgrades, and customization options
[*] Deeper rally content, new environments, and ongoing updates!
[/list]
We hope this change makes it easier and more fun for everyone to explore what RMS has to offer. Whether you're a newcomer, a curious player, or someone on the fence about upgrading, LIGHT EDITION is our way of making Rally Mechanic Simulator more accessible, transparent, and enjoyable for all. And if you’re loving your time in the LIGHT EDITION, upgrading is the best way to dive deeper into the world of rally mechanics.

More news soon as we roll out the update next week!

notes.title: Devlog #14 - The most important PART (let's talk about PARTS) 🛠️
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Mechanics![/h1]
When it comes to Rally Mechanic Simulator, it’s all about the details. Creating realistic car parts is the core of our game, and today we’re excited to take you behind the scenes to show how we bring those parts to life—from the first concept to the final 3D model.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/e3c4fef430ee7f4940fbb4bc4a37a6a5743decd8.png[/img]

Every car part starts with thorough research. Our artists dive into photos, technical drawings, and real-life examples to understand the exact shapes, sizes, and materials needed. This stage is crucial for understanding shapes, sizes, and materials. Using tools like Blender, Maya, and Substance 3D Painter, we craft each part step-by-step, paying close attention to how light interacts with different surfaces, ensuring every bolt, screw, and panel feels authentic. Once the model is shaped, we fine-tune every detail, from bolts to textures, and then optimize it to keep the game running smoothly. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/257495ae8065edb270d7183d491a54a3494fbb80.gif[/img]

The time needed to model a part can vary. Simple parts might take a few hours, while complex ones can require up to two weeks. We balance accuracy and performance, relying on detailed references to ensure our models look and feel true to life. Many of our artists have spent time working with real car components, so they have a good sense of what details matter the most. Their mechanical experience adds an extra layer of authenticity to the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/fd79843d03aa82751d3dd1fdf19d7c6c03c82121.gif[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/69c6d1d8106cf6e2c3fd662b2d49a2d76968d2bf.png[/img]

Modeling challenging parts like engine blocks requires a blend of creativity and precision. These components are filled with tiny details that must look accurate while keeping the game running smoothly. To achieve this, we often use techniques like normal mapping, which allows us to create detailed textures without straining performance. Our team’s hands-on experience with real car parts helps us make informed choices, ensuring our models not only look good but also function correctly in-game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/2ddafe3c747abdb06d82393ed9c6244320508896.gif[/img]

Our workflow has evolved to make the process more efficient. We now use shared materials for texturing, making updates quicker, and keeping everything consistent. We’ve also refined our optimization techniques, allowing us to deliver stunning visuals without sacrificing performance. Each new model we create builds on the lessons we've learned, helping us reach higher standards of quality.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/1970ef5fa1d2673afdd3a3ae06969a9db0d2cfcf.gif[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/fc13bf3b0eff446fe35112a8a7add511ec1d2710.png[/img]

notes.title: Under the Hood of RMS: Tuning Up for the Rally
notes.content:
[h2]How's it going, Mechanics? 🛠️[/h2]
We want to extend a huge thank you to everyone who played the [b]Prologue of Rally Mechanic Simulator[/b]! Your support, feedback, and enthusiasm have been invaluable, and we're thrilled to have you with us on this journey. Your passion has motivated us to keep pushing the boundaries, and now we’re excited to share a preview of what’s coming next.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059776/ec93741758f3d81b2fbb5fef95b43c8f38fcc94f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059776/5f21572511a9fb3d2068c301e834a2a0415d1046.gif[/img]
[h1]Unmatched Realism in Every Detail [/h1]
Every car is designed to reflect the true intricacies of a rally vehicle. From the textured surfaces of the bodywork to the fine details of each mechanical part - every element is carefully crafted to bring the car to life. The inner components, like the engine and suspension, are equally realistic, showcasing the complexity of rally cars. With realistic lighting, every curve, bolt, and surface is highlighted, making the cars shine with authenticity. The result is a highly immersive experience, where each vehicle feels like it’s ready to take on the toughest rallies, with a level of detail that makes it almost feel like you could reach out and touch it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059776/44fde05c1777983dfc479efa8ffe9fa96d5314ff.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059776/d7b3716ddc55cf6e1c3e071fab4dce82ec0ddcc2.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059776/a8dde0bcdddb2abecee6830e8e4bbeeb233bb993.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059776/a43f7e7314bd70db5b417d8295660eca5cb210c3.gif[/img]
[h1]New locations to fine-tune every car [/h1]
[b]Paint Shop:[/b] Customize and personalize every rally car that comes into your care. The Paint Shop is fully equipped with a wide range of colors, textures, and finishes, allowing you to create unique designs that stand out on the track. Whether it’s a simple touch-up or a complete makeover, your creativity is the only limit!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059776/2d4b6b54c2a9778640c403c9455d9b387de55444.gif[/img]
[b]Dyno Testing Room:[/b] Ever wonder if all that hard work paid off? The Dyno Testing Room is where you’ll find out. Strap the car in, fire up the engine, and put your modifications to the test. Measure power output, torque, and other vital stats to fine-tune each car to perfection. It’s the ultimate performance challenge for every dedicated mechanic!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059776/1b33bcd248087a7b8bd871c62641d8cb229b6173.gif[/img]
[b]Diagnostics Center:[/b] Dive deeper into the technical side of rally car maintenance with our all-new Diagnostics Center. Utilize advanced scanning tools and diagnostic equipment to pinpoint issues, optimize performance, and ensure every vehicle is race-ready. This new area gives you a more hands-on and detailed approach to troubleshooting.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059776/a8dde0bcdddb2abecee6830e8e4bbeeb233bb993.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059776/6409bac08509d6d7a33078a43dbcd17545682c33.gif[/img]
[h1]Enhanced Lighting & Visuals [/h1]
We’re introducing a brand-new lighting system that adds depth and realism to every corner of your workshop. From the gleam of polished metal to the shadows cast by your tools, the improved lighting brings out the finest details and creates a more immersive and atmospheric environment. Expect your garage to feel more alive and authentic than ever before.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059776/9575a72142260e9925b5c1ddd93d8cfd47aeb727.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059776/7da7871aff5b86cddcd7b31f003c51051a1bc4db.gif[/img]

[h1]Wishlist the Full Game![/h1]
We’re just getting started, and we have so much more planned for the full version of Rally Mechanic Simulator. Your wishlist adds make a huge difference, helping us reach more players and keep the excitement going. By adding RMS to your wishlist, you’ll stay up-to-date with all the latest announcements, updates, and special offers.
Thank you once again for your incredible support and for being a crucial part of our community. We can't wait to share the full Rally Mechanic Simulator experience with you soon!

notes.title: Hotfix #2 is Live! Join our Dev Live Chat on Friday!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello mechanics![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059776/8a5018d0e0564eaff5cf4b074a0b9ae4a045226b.png[/img]
We’ve been receiving plenty of feedback from you guys. It’s absolutely great for two reasons:
[olist]
[*] we get to [b]fix the game[/b],
[*] it means [b]you care[/b]!
[/olist]
So yeah, even though it’s just the prologue, we’re following up the first hotfix with another one. There are fewer fixes now, but they were more difficult to figure out than the earlier ones, so we’re kinda proud of ourselves!

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with wrong subtitles appearing when changing the language during the service.
[*] Fixed the faulty visualization of braking while driving (your car won’t be randomly showing braking lights while driving).
[*] Font correction with missing characters for the Chinese language.
[*] Fixed blocking of the camera after a quick exit from the car after disassembling parts.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059776/24a3c5890b196497341617876a47fe10af7c7dad.gif[/img]

Aleks from the development team will host a live chat on our[url=https://discord.gg/vWjaxFbF] Discord server[/url] this Friday [b](26th of July)[/b] at [b]6 PM CEST.[/b] He’ll be showcasing some of the things he’s been working on and you will have a possibility to talk to him and to give him suggestions on how to modify the driving model of the game!

notes.title: Hotfix #1 is here!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey there, Mechanics![/h1]

We've just rolled out our first patch, fixing a bunch of bugs. Huge thanks for the awesome reception - we know bugs happen, so your feedback means the world to us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059776/0c3fc02f2d38f022825ae6d61581e72dd05057e6.png[/img]

[h2]Patch notes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed typos in localization.
[*] Fixed UI elements that weren't localized properly.
[*] UI changes (so it would be clearer in some languages).
[*] Fixed an issue that made playing the game impossible when using an alphabet other than en-US.
[*] Changed behavior of outlines when in service mode or working with screws.
[*] Fixed saving and loading of some settings.
[*] Fixed UI that was positioned wrong during the rally.
[*] Improved some animations.
[*] Fixed relations between parts in the boxer engine.
[*] Turned off interactions with floor and engine covers.
[*] Fixed a screw positioning issue that occurred when canceling assembly/disassembly.
[*] Fixed an issue with part names not showing up when a player goes to a rally again.
[*] Fixed an issue with the wrong UI key hints display.
[/list]
We're always eager to hear from you, so drop by our [url=https://discord.gg/atpUy3yqFM]Discord server[/url].
